title: Automatic generation of heuristic dispatching rules for dynamic hybrid flow shop scheduling via personalized multi-island reflective evolution

parentSelection: Island-local random pairing with equal-fitness exclusion

mechanism.domainTask: LLM evolution of dispatching-rule code for dynamic hybrid flow-shop scheduling
mechanism.populationDetail: Three parallel islands each maintain 20 heuristic-code individuals in the experiments, with island-local selection and periodic ring migration.
mechanism.archiveDetail: Each island separately preserves its best-so-far heuristic and includes it in local parent selection.
mechanism.replacementDetail: Crossover replaces the island population generation-wise; mutation offspring are inserted incrementally; migration replaces recipient worst individuals with source best individuals.
mechanism.generationDetail: Crossover synthesizes two selected parent rules using verbal reflection; mutation edits the current island elite using long-term reflection and its personality.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: Long-term reflection aggregates prior short-term reflections and guides subsequent elite mutation.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: Randomly samples pairs from the island population plus its elite while rejecting pairs with equal objective values.
mechanism.outOfTaxonomy: LLM-generated persistent island personalities condition search operators and create differentiated exploration policies across parallel populations.
